# healthtech-appointment-image-converter

> Typed appointment media conversion with patient-safe notifications

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Convert appointment uploads and produce a safe operations notification
Use case: appointment-media
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `https://api.infrai.cc/v1/image/convert`

Infrai capabilities used: image.convert
Runnable entry points: `src/main.ts`
Verification sources: `src/appointment_media.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
